title: Hodge on X x X Implies Grothendieck's Lefschetz Standard Conjecture B: Lean 4 Formalization

description: Zero-sorry Lean 4 module (StandardConjectures.lean) and companion note formalizing the implication hodge_on_product_implies_lefschetz_B: if the inverse Lefschetz operator Λ = L^{-1} is a rational Hodge class on X × X and the rational Hodge conjecture holds on X × X in that degree, then Λ is algebraic (Grothendieck's Lefschetz Standard Conjecture B).
